name: Large Throwing Wheel
ability: Once per round, when you form a Vase or Censer during a Forming Studio action, ignore that vessel's Clay cost. This does not create an additional vessel or increase the action's limit.
abilityZh: 每轮一次，在制坯坊行动中制作瓶或炉时，无需支付该器物的陶土费用。此能力不会额外制作器物，也不增加该行动的上限。

name: Measuring Calipers
ability: After you form a vessel of a second different Shape this round, gain 1 Coin and 1 Clay.
abilityZh: 本轮当你制作第二种不同器形的器物后，获得1铜钱和1陶土。

name: Clay Substitution
ability: Once per round, on your turn or before Contribution cards are chosen during the Firing Phase, pay 3 Coins to gain 3 resources in any combination of Clay and Wood.
abilityZh: 每轮一次，在你的回合中，或在烧制阶段选择出柴牌之前，支付3铜钱，获得任意搭配的3个陶土或柴薪。

name: Drying Frames
ability: Once per round, after you form a vessel, immediately apply a Glaze and Plain Decoration at no Coin cost. That vessel cannot be loaded into the kiln until the following round.
abilityZh: 每回合一次，成型坯体后，立即为其施加釉色与素面装饰，无需支付铜钱。该坯体在下一回合之前不能装入窑中。

name: Carving Knives
ability: Ignore the Coin cost of every Carved Decoration you apply. Once per round, you may change the Decoration on one of your Glazed, unloaded ceramics to Carved at no cost.
abilityZh: 你施加的每个刻花装饰均无需支付铜钱。每回合一次，你可以将一件已施釉且未装窑的器物的装饰改为刻花，无需费用。

name: Seal Stamps
ability: Ignore the Coin cost of every Impressed Decoration you apply. Once per round, you may change the Decoration on one of your Glazed, unloaded ceramics to Impressed at no cost.
abilityZh: 你施加的每个印花装饰均无需支付铜钱。每回合一次，你可以将一件已施釉且未装窑的器物的装饰改为印花，无需费用。

name: Colour Samples
ability: When you take an Order at the Office, look at the top 3 cards of either Order deck, take 1, and place the rest on the bottom of that deck.
abilityZh: 在贡务处获取订单时，查看任一订单牌堆顶的3张牌，选取1张，其余置于该牌堆底部。

name: Kiln Setting
ability: Before Wood Contributions are chosen, move any number of your loaded ceramics to empty active kiln spaces. Resolve moves one at a time; a space you vacate counts as empty.
abilityZh: 出柴牌选定之前，将任意数量的已装窑器物移至空置的启用窑位。逐一结算移动；你腾出的窑位视为空位。

name: Protective Saggars
ability: After Quality is assigned, spend 1 Wood to improve one of your ceramics by one step from Flawed to Standard or Standard to Fine. It cannot create a Masterpiece.
abilityZh: 判定品第后，花费1柴薪，将你1件器物提升一级：次品升为标准，或标准升为精品。不能造就珍品。

name: Fuel Ledger
ability: After all Contribution cards are revealed but before Base Heat is determined, if you revealed Stoke the Fire, you may spend 1 additional Wood. If you do, your Stoke gives +2 Heat instead of +1 this firing.
abilityZh: 所有出柴牌揭示后、基础火候确定之前，若你揭示的是添薪，可额外花费1柴薪。若如此做，本次烧制中你的添薪改为+2火候而非+1。

name: Test Pieces
ability: Before Contribution cards are chosen, pay 1 Wood to privately look at the top card of the Fire deck, then return it to the top.
abilityZh: 选择出柴牌之前，支付1柴薪，私下查看火焰牌堆顶的1张牌，然后将其放回牌堆顶部。

name: Kiln Records
ability: After firing is fully resolved, if you had at least one ceramic in the kiln, gain 1 Clay and 1 Coin.
abilityZh: 烧制全部结算后，若你在窑中至少有1件器物，获得1陶土和1铜钱。

name: Connoisseur Network
ability: After a normal Office main action, you may sell exactly one Finished undelivered ceramic and return its Vessel: Standard 3 Coins, Fine 6 Coins, or Masterpiece 10 Coins. It cannot follow Court Patronage.
abilityZh: 在贡务处执行常规主行动后，你可以出售恰好1件已完成且未交付的器物并归还其坯体卡：合格品3铜钱、精品6铜钱、珍品10铜钱。不能在朝廷恩荫之后使用。

name: Second Firing
ability: After Quality is assigned, return one of your Standard ceramics from the current firing to Glazed without a Quality.
abilityZh: 判定品第后，将你1件合格品退回施釉区并移除其品第；日后可再次烧制。

name: Sagger Selection
ability: After the Fire card is revealed, spend 2 Wood. For one of your ceramics, treat the Fire modifier as 1 step closer to 0 this firing.
abilityZh: 火焰牌揭示后，花费2柴薪。本次烧制中，你的1件器物视火焰调整值向0靠近1步。
